body.query: query KnownDrugs($id: String!) { target(ensemblId: $id) { id drugAndClinicalCandidates { count rows { id maxClinicalStage drug { id name drugType maximumClinicalStage mechanismsOfAction { rows { mechanismOfAction actionType targetName targets { id approvedSymbol } } } } diseases { diseaseFromSource disease { id name } } clinicalReports { id type source url trialPhase clinicalStage trialOverallStatus year trialWhyStopped diseases { disease { id name } } } } } } }
